doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: The Rika band and funeral bands
title: How the Eureka-Rika band got its name from the Rika Society
summary: Martin explains that the Rika band was named after the Rika Society at the Cut-Off. Willie Parker and others hired a hall there and came back to set up the band, which Tom later played in.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
